steps.title: Opposition
steps.body: Many pawn endings are decided by opposition: your king stands directly in front of the enemy king with one square between them. The side that must move usually loses ground.

steps.question: What is opposition?
options: Kings facing each other with one square between them
Two pawns on the same file
steps.explanation: Opposition is when the kings face each other with one square between them.

steps.title: Promote
steps.body: Push the pawn on a7 to a8 and promote it to a queen.
steps.hint: Pawns promote on the last rank. Choose the queen.
steps.success: Queen! The pawn is now the strongest piece on the board.
